top_signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Rabobank's Foley Sees 'Weakened' Confidence in Dollar
top_signals.summary: Jane Foley, Rabobank's FX strategy head, discusses the reaction of the dollar following stronger-than-expected payrolls data. She also comments on what upcoming CPI data could mean for the currency. "If this number is on the stronger side of expectations, we will still get a bit of a boost for the dollar," Foley tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
